column1: # Every served task and the datetime its own specification carries, read off the pinned
# corpus. Production builds a task's backlog against this date (see `AppWorldEnv._backlog`),
# and 31 of the 318 are not the reference date the rest share, so a roster test that assumed
# one date for all of them was not testing the inputs a run uses.
# Committed so the offline ledger tests can use production's own inputs without a corpus. It
# is checked against the live corpus by test_appworld_table.py, which is where the corpus is
# provisioned; regenerate it there whenever the manifest or the pinned bundle moves.
